name: k8s-api-troubleshooting
description: Use when the Kubernetes API server itself refuses or fails a request, before any controller acts on it: "failed calling webhook", "admission webhook ... denied the request", "ValidatingAdmissionPolicy ... denied request", a ReplicaSet with FailedCreate and no pods, an APIService "False (ServiceNotFound)", "FailedDiscoveryCheck" or "MissingEndpoints", "unable to retrieve the complete list of server APIs", a namespace stuck in Terminating, "no matches for kind" or "ensure CRDs are installed first", "strict decoding error: unknown field", a conversion webhook failure, "You must be logged in to the server (Unauthorized)", 429 "too many requests", "etcdserver:" errors, "Request entity too large" or "metadata.annotations: Too long". Investigates with kubectl get, describe, events and the health endpoints, and proposes fixes. Reads first and asks before changing anything.
